reason: Evidence shows this plugin is primarily a user-facing settings UI addition for DeepSeek Harness: it adds a General settings panel called "Custom Instructions" and backend routes that read/write ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md. Its functional effect is to let users configure global instructions that apply across sessions/models by editing that file, so classification is navigation-panel utility with file-backed persistence.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置中提供“自定义指令”面板，用于读取和保存本机级的 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，使会话可复用统一的全局指令。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Custom Instructions panel in DeepSeek Harness settings to read and save the machine-level ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md file, enabling shared global instructions across conversations.

capabilities: Adds a web settings panel in DeepSeek Harness to edit a global instruction file
Provides local endpoints to read and write AGENTS.md content
Persists user-entered instructions across sessions by targeting ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md

reasons.code: Host layer registers GET/POST routes for /custom-instructions to read/write ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md, indicating local file access and modification behavior.
Client layer adds a General settings panel item and uses fetch on open/save to load and persist instruction text.
Repository is a DSH plugin package with web client injection and a settings-panel intent, confirming primary purpose as UI integration rather than external service tooling.
